title: The Story of Al Baydha:  A Regenerative Agriculture in the Saudi Desert.  قصة مشروع البيضاء
summary: Al Baydha project co-founder Neal Spackman gives a final update nine years in, explaining how desertification followed the loss of indigenous land management and how the land has changed since inputs stopped in 2016. It lists which species worked best.
why: HN cites it as encouraging evidence that deserts can be regenerated and greened.
